title: Reporting back to Teleshko

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Is the license for the bodega settled?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is the license for the bodega settled?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: For our future interactions, bear in mind I prefer clarity. Should I ask the question again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For our future interactions, bear in mind I prefer clarity. Should I ask the question again?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Nor should he be, considering his performance. Nor am I.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nor should he be, considering his performance. Nor am I.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well that depends on your response to my next question. Did Brooke attempt to involve you in any schemes or chicanery?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well that depends on your response to my next question. Did Brooke attempt to involve you in any schemes or chicanery?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Well unless you have anything more to share with me, the LICC is yours...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well unless you have anything more to share with me, the LICC is yours...

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Indeed. And his brother is dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. And his brother is dead.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Yes, very good. Only one small problem... I don't believe you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, very good. Only one small problem... I don't believe you.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: It is not. And please do mistake me for a fool again. I had you surveilled. I know everything he said to you. And please believe me when I say everything that happened was as predicted. It is impossible to overestimate you. Go now. We will talk later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is not. And please do mistake me for a fool again. I had you surveilled. I know everything he said to you. And please believe me when I say everything that happened was as predicted. It is impossible to overestimate you. Go now. We will talk later.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Yes. I'm glad you were not tempted by his schemes...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I'm glad you were not tempted by his schemes...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know what you mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know what you mean.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know what you mean.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait. I have to tell you something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait. I have to tell you something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait. I have to tell you something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait. I have to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Brooke already sold the business license to his brother.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Brooke already sold the business license to his brother.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Brooke already sold the business license to his brother.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Brooke already sold the business license to his brother.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, it was all a scam. He was trying to trick you. No need to thank me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, it was all a scam. He was trying to trick you. No need to thank me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, it was all a scam. He was trying to trick you. No need to thank me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, it was all a scam. He was trying to trick you. No need to thank me.
